svg.title: The forced tool costs W-2 accuracy; structured output matches the prompt
svg.desc: RealKIE invoices, 20 documents × 3 runs: Schema in prompt · Haiku 5.5 83% at $25.6 per 1,000 documents, Structured output · Haiku 5.5 (baseline setup) 80% at $22.0 per 1,000 documents, Schema in prompt · Sonnet 5.5 82% at $90.3 per 1,000 documents, Structured output · Sonnet 5.5 83% at $85.4 per 1,000 documents, Forced tool · Haiku 5.5 82% at $22.1 per 1,000 documents, Schema in prompt · Nova 2 Lite 76% at $24.3 per 1,000 documents, Forced tool · Nova 2 Lite 67% at $22.0 per 1,000 documents; Fake-W2 forms, 20 documents × 3 runs: Schema in prompt · Haiku 5.5 100% at $7.61 per 1,000 documents, Structured output · Haiku 5.5 (baseline setup) 100% at $7.51 per 1,000 documents, Schema in prompt · Sonnet 5.5 100% at $20.7 per 1,000 documents, Structured output · Sonnet 5.5 100% at $20.0 per 1,000 documents, Forced tool · Haiku 5.5 92% at $7.42 per 1,000 documents, Schema in prompt · Nova 2 Lite 86% at $8.51 per 1,000 documents, Forced tool · Nova 2 Lite 83% at $8.80 per 1,000 documents; Baseline setup: Amazon Textract with Layout only; holistic classification reading text and page images, single-pass extraction with structured output, and confidence scoring, all on Claude Haiku 5.5, with no escalation to a second scoring model.
